authority.rule: API_UNREACHABLE recovery must be deterministic, bounded and state-machine safe.

recovery_rules.name: Retry Verhalten
recovery_rules.rule: Retry is allowed only for transient technical connectivity failures: API_UNREACHABLE and TIMEOUT. It is not allowed for AUTH_REQUIRED, FORBIDDEN, WORKSPACE_NOT_CONFIGURED or VALIDATION_ERROR.
recovery_rules.state_effect: Retry clears the retryable bootstrap error and re-enters authenticating or workspace_loading through the normal bootstrap path.

recovery_rules.name: Reconnect Interval
recovery_rules.rule: Automatic reconnect uses bounded exponential backoff with jitter: 2s, 5s, 10s, 20s, then capped at 30s. Maximum automatic attempts per outage window: 5.
recovery_rules.state_effect: After max attempts the UI remains in api_unreachable with manual retry only.

recovery_rules.name: Manual Retry
recovery_rules.rule: Manual retry is always user-triggered, disabled while a retry request is in flight, and resets the next automatic retry timer.
recovery_rules.state_effect: Manual retry may run immediately, but must still validate auth and workspace before returning to workspace_ready.

recovery_rules.name: Stale Session Handling
recovery_rules.rule: A stored token is not trusted after connectivity recovery until /api/v1/auth/me succeeds. 401 clears token and session state; 403 enters forbidden; network failure preserves the stored token but does not mark it valid.
recovery_rules.state_effect: No workspace-scoped request may be issued from stale session state.

recovery_rules.name: Reconnect waehrend Login
recovery_rules.rule: If login fails with API_UNREACHABLE or TIMEOUT, no token, user or workspace state is written. Manual retry resubmits login credentials only after explicit user action.
recovery_rules.state_effect: State remains unauthenticated or api_unreachable; there is no partial authenticated state.

recovery_rules.name: Reconnect waehrend Workspace Bootstrap
recovery_rules.rule: If /auth/me or workspace bootstrap fails with API_UNREACHABLE or TIMEOUT after a token exists, the token may remain stored as unvalidated, but active_workspace_id is not trusted until /auth/me succeeds.
recovery_rules.state_effect: Protected routes stay blocked; stale route data may be read-only only when visibly marked stale.

recovery_rules.name: Kein Retry Storm
recovery_rules.rule: Only one reconnect attempt may be in flight per browser tab. New manual retry aborts or supersedes pending timer; automatic attempts are capped and jittered.
recovery_rules.state_effect: Duplicate retries must not create concurrent auth/bootstrap requests.

recovery_rules.name: Kein Spinner Loop
recovery_rules.rule: A loading spinner must have a terminal path: success, retryable error state, non-retryable error state or timeout. API_UNREACHABLE must render an error state with Retry, not an infinite loading state.
recovery_rules.state_effect: authenticating and workspace_loading must stop loading after the request timeout or failure classification.

recovery_rules.name: Keine State Corruption
recovery_rules.rule: Late responses from superseded retries may not write auth, workspace or route data unless their request generation matches the current runtime generation.
recovery_rules.state_effect: Old responses are ignored after logout, new login, workspace switch or newer retry.

conditionally_retryable_codes: CORS_ERROR only if caused by local transient connectivity/configuration and exposed as retryable by UI

side_effects: disable login submit while in flight

forbidden_transitions.reason: Recovery requires successful auth and workspace validation.
Workspace validation may not be skipped.
Reconnect success must validate auth/workspace and refresh stale caches first.
Connectivity failure must not be rendered as empty data.
